Join us on 11 November in Singapore for an evening of celebration, recognition and exceptional networking!

 

Following an unforgettable evening last year, we're excited to bring

the Infra Global Investor Awards and Infra Global ESG Awards together once again, gathering leading investors, developers, financiers and industry professionals from across APAC's energy and infrastructure sectors

 

The awards will honour the organisations, transactions and individuals making a significant impact through outstanding achievements in fundraising, capital deployment and M&A, as well as those setting new standards in environmental, social and governance practices.

 

 See who’s been shortlisted for the Investor and ESG APAC Awards:
